# Covenant Ademola

> AI Engineer & Automation Specialist. Builds AI agents, CRM automations, and
> full websites for real businesses, then coaches other professionals to do
> the same.

Covenant Ademola (also written Ademola Covenant) is an AI automation and
systems specialist based in Nigeria, working remotely with clients across
Canada, the United States, Ireland, and the UK. Covenant builds AI lead generation
systems, AI voice and chat agents, CRM automations and workflow automations
for real estate companies, web design agencies, law practices, e-commerce
stores and coaching businesses, using n8n, Make, Zapier, GoHighLevel, Claude
and OpenAI.

## Summary

- Built the entire technology stack for Tempho Luxe, a Canadian real estate
  company: their website, a 24/7 AI voice agent, a conversational AI agent
  across social and SMS channels, and the CRM/automation system managing
  1,820+ landlord and tenant opportunities.
- Built a lead-generation and outreach system for a UK real estate firm that
  replaced the manual work of seven people.
- Architected the entire operations and CRM system from zero for Vistahand
  (Ireland).
- Built the website, lead-nurture automation, and e-commerce automation for
  AI with Ann (aiwithann.uk), a UK digital marketer and educator.
- Automated legal document management for a Canadian law practice.
- Coaches 300+ professionals — including lawyers, cybersecurity experts, HR
  managers, and data analysts — at AI Focused Academy on how to build AI
  automations themselves.
- Works primarily with n8n, Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel, Apify, and LLM APIs
  (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), and builds full-stack products
  using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code.

## Case studies

- /work/tempho-luxe — AI voice agent, CRM and website for a Canadian real
  estate company (Tempho Luxe). 1,820+ opportunities managed, 3,360 landlords
  reached, 53 listings converted.
- /work/ai-lead-generation-agency — AI lead generation and website audit
  system for a US web design agency. Seven Make scenarios find businesses,
  audit their websites with Claude, score each lead and deliver it to
  GoHighLevel daily with the pitch written.
- /work/uk-real-estate-ai-agent — one AI agent that replaced the work of
  seven people at a UK real estate firm: every landlord reply handled, leads
  qualified in under 60 seconds, automatic day-by-day follow-up.
